attributes.visState: {"title": "[FinOps] Identified vs recs bubble", "type": "vega", "aggs": [], "params": {"spec": "{\"$schema\": \"https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json\", \"description\": \"Each bubble is an account. X is identified monthly USD (open+in_progress). Y is rec count. Size is identified. Not trailing spend.\", \"autosize\": {\"type\": \"fit\", \"contains\": \"padding\"}, \"data\": {\"url\": {\"%type%\": \"esql\", \"%context%\": true, \"%timefield%\": \"@timestamp\", \"query\": \"FROM finops-rightsizing-latest*\\n| WHERE finops.rightsizing.status IN (\\\"open\\\", \\\"in_progress\\\")\\n| EVAL account = CASE(\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"985408759551\\\", \\\"apm-stage\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"041298796264\\\", \\\"monitoring / elastic-integration\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"439106060789\\\", \\\"ESF (439106060789)\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id == \\\"119672459156\\\", \\\"ESF (119672459156)\\\",\\n    cloud.account.id\\n)\\n| STATS identified = ROUND(SUM(finops.rightsizing.estimated_monthly_savings), 2), recs = COUNT(*)\\n    BY account\\n| SORT identified DESC\\n| LIMIT 12\"}}, \"mark\": {\"type\": \"circle\", \"opacity\": 0.8, \"stroke\": \"#1a1a1a\", \"tooltip\": true}, \"encoding\": {\"x\": {\"field\": \"identified\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Identified USD / mo\"}, \"y\": {\"field\": \"recs\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Open recs\"}, \"size\": {\"field\": \"identified\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Identified USD / mo\", \"scale\": {\"range\": [80, 400]}}, \"color\": {\"field\": \"account\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Account\"}}}"}}
